question: Find the display names of users who obtained a badge within one year of creating their account, posted at least one question in 2011 with more than 20,000 views, and own a post with above-average view count.

arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052"
      AND (julianday(b."XCL_004") - julianday(u."XCL_054")) <= 365
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
      AND p."XCL_027" = 1
      AND strftime('%Y', p."XCL_029") = '2011'
      AND p."XCL_030" > 20000
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS owned
    WHERE owned."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
      AND owned."XCL_030" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_030") FROM posts)
  )

FROM users AS u
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052"
      AND (julianday(b."XCL_004") - julianday(u."XCL_054")) <= 365
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
      AND p."XCL_027" = 1
      AND strftime('%Y', p."XCL_029") = '2011'
      AND p."XCL_030" > 20000
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS owned
    WHERE owned."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
      AND owned."XCL_030" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_030") FROM posts)
  )

FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T1."XCL_052" = T3."XCL_033"
WHERE (julianday(T2."XCL_004") - julianday(T1."XCL_054")) <= 365
  AND strftime('%Y', T3."XCL_029") = '2011'

  AND T3."XCL_031" > 20000
  AND T3."XCL_031" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_031") FROM posts)
